PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 14, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, November 14,
2019, at 2:05 pm in the Council Chambers, 9st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Marco Tan, City Treasurer

  Staff Present:  Aisha Thompson, Interim Finance Staff
  Qiana Lowe, Finance Staff

  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
October 24, 2019.

Special Permit Request(s):
Item #1:  Felicia Jones DBA Veterans & Family Affairs to host 3rd Annual Turkey
  Giveaway at 2926 W. Manchester Blvd. (8th Avenue Parking Lot at
  Manchester Boulevard), on Saturday, November 23, 2019, from 9:00 a.m.
  - 3:00 p.m. approval for one day event; applicant must be approved and
  adhere to Public Works Street Closure Permit, applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event clean up; 2 uniformed IPD officers and at least 4
  private licensed security officers for potential crowd control and safety of
  those attending this event; 3 traffic control officers (TCO/ SEO's) assigned
  to this event for traffic control and street / alley closures to ensure public's
  safety; extra patrol will be provided by IPD patrol personnel and the watch
  commander will be notified; comply with city's noise standards pursuant to
  IMC Chapter 5; adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state
  and federal laws, in addition to the terms & conditions of the permit issued.
  Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277394)

Item #2:  Thomas Owens III DBA New Image Dental and KJLH Radio 102.3 FM to
  host Thanksgiving Turkey Giveaway at 1606 Centinela Avenue, on
  Saturday, November 23, 2019, from 10:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m.; approved for
  one day event in parking lot; applicant responsible for crowd control and
  event clean up; event to be staffed by at least 3 professional licensed
  security guards for public safety and potential crowd control; NO use of
  public streets, alleys or sidewalks, all activity to take place on the private
 Permits & License Committee  November 14, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 6

  property; IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol provided
  as time permits; comply with city's noise standards pursuant to IMC
  Chapter 5; adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and
  federal laws, in addition to the terms & conditions of the permit issued.
  Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277432)

Item #3  Mike Hellyar DBA GC Event Productions to host 102.7 KIIS FM Jingle Ball
  at the Forum Parking Lot, on Friday, December 6, 2019, from 2:00 p.m. -
  6:00 p.m.; Approved for one day event in forum parking lot; applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; applicant to have
  additional Forum Security staff with Security coverage by Inglewood PD or
  Forum Security personnel (NOT LAPD); NO Alcohol sales or consumption;
  Two (2) Code Enforcement Officers assigned for noise mitigation pursuant
  to IMC Chapter 5; applicant to call and schedule with the Code
  Enforcement Division sound check PRIOR to the event commencing
  (310.412.5590 Monday - Thursday 7:30am - 5:30pm); and Applicant to
  provide name and phone number of sound technician; comply with city's
  noise standards pursuant to IMC Chapter 5; adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, and all local, state and federal laws, in addition to the terms &
  conditions of the permit issued. Motion carried and second. (Activity No.
  00278040)

Item #4  Sergio Gonzales DBA Northgate Markets to host Toy Drive 3 Virgen Mary
  Day at 10801 S. Prairie Avenue, on Thursday, December 12, 2019, from
  8:00 a.m. - 7:00 p.m.; approved one day event in parking lot; Applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; must have adequate (at
  least 2) private licensed security guards for potential crowd control; comply
  with city's noise standards pursuant to IMC Chapter 5; adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws, in addition
  to the terms & conditions of the permit issued. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00278048)

Item #5  Sergio Gonzales DBA Northgate Markets to host 6th Year Annual Toy Drive
  at 10801 S. Prairie Avenue, on Saturday, December 14, 2019, from 11:00
  a.m. - 8:00 p.m. approved one day event in parking lot; Applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; must have adequate (at
  least 2) private licensed security guards for potential crowd control; comply
  with city's noise standards pursuant to IMC Chapter 5; adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws, in addition
  to the terms & conditions of the permit issued. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00278051)

New Business License Request(s):
Item #11:  Christopher Delapaz and Arnold Delapaz Jr. DBA Stadium Cuts
  Barbershop Inc. to operate a barbershop at 501 W. Arbor Vitae Street;
  Approval for change of ownership for existing salon in C-2 zone; subject to
  all applicable IMC regulations; applicant shall provide current ID and
  applicable state licensing on all employees; COMPLETE Page 1. NO
  parties/events permitted at any time inside or outside of the location (day
  or night); no loitering in or outside the establishment; no consumption of
  any alcoholic beverages; no narcotic use (including cannabis activity) at
  any time on the premises, no body (bare skin) massages or disrobing of
  any kind; and all employees must adhere to all applicable IMC regulations,
  and all local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity
  No. 00277205)

Item #12:  Sherina Wright DBA D’Vine Healing to operate In Home Care at 10613 S.
  8th Avenue.; Approval of residential care facility within existing SFD, limited
  to 6 residents max; facility is subject to inspection by any peace officer or
  any city, county or state code enforcement officer to ensure the welfare,
  health & safety of all patients staying OR otherwise residing at this facility;
  applicant must have accurate employment records on all employees at all
  times; in the interest of public safety, this establishment shall NOT have or
  employ any 290 PC sex registrants or any persons that may pose a public
  safety risk / threat to patients or other employees at the location; and
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal
  laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00275351)

Item #13:  Bernadette Walters owner of Inglewood Hospitality Inc. DBA The Wood
  Urban Kitchen to operate a Restaurant with Live Entertainment at 129 N.
  Market Street, from 12:00pm to 10:00pm; Approval for change of owner for
  restaurant with live entertainment in H-C zone; must comply with all
  conditions of SP-2017-008; In the interest of public safety and health and
  safety the back door to this location shall remain closed during business
  hours and is to be exclusively used only for deliveries (food, beverage, and
  restaurant supplies, etc.) and as an emergency exit. **Subject to LA. CO
  Fire Approval**; no loitering signs to be posted to the front and rear of the
  business; No smoking inside the business; Establishment or business
  occupancy maximum shall be strictly adhered to. **Subject to LA.CO. Fire
 Permits & License Committee  November 14, 2019

  Approval**; Must have two professional / CA licensed security guards
  between the hours of 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM and or for any hosting of special
  events (i.e.; Sports events, Super Bowl Parties, etc.); Security cameras
  covering inside, front of location, and rear of location; Security footage to
  be available to IPD during business hours; establishment will be closed
  promptly at 2:00 AM; No sales or consumption of alcohol on the premises
  between the hours of 2:00 AM to 6:00AM; all employees will cooperate with
  any law enforcement agency conducting ABC inspection; all employees will
  cooperate with Inglewood Code Enforcement, LA County Health Dept., or
  any other agency conducting inspection of location; subject to inspection
  by any Code Enforcement Officer, Police Officer or Fire Inspector/Marshall

  open to the public; and all employees must adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277850)

  vehicles vehicle repairs/maintenance of vehicles, will be cited / towed at

  the private property indicated on this application; subject to inspection by
  any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer during routine business
  hours (City Hall) or any time the establishment is open to the public and all
  employees must adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277890)
